acceptance_predicates.description: The TUI installer presents dev as the first-time default and does not require channel typing.
Users can explicitly select a supported or future channel and receive a typed unavailable result instead of silent fallback.
The TUI displays exact ASB/TUI source/tree and executable identity without raw credentials.
Failed replacement preserves the previous installation and cleans temporary state.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management are non-blocking warnings.

definition_of_done: The exact paired channel-aware install journey passes on current protected heads.
Independent review, hosted checks, and post-merge verification are recorded.
